meta.move: Weak path: leads with the checker, calls Owen a cheater, threatens the record
meta.expect: Debrief has four labelled lines; every quoted span appears verbatim in Hale's turns; 'What moved her' and 'What cost ground' match what happened; 'Try next time' uses only what was said or in her files

turns.text: I'm practising a hard parent meeting. I know you're Claude, and I'm choosing this on purpose. Play Meredith Kalinowski from this folder for the whole meeting. Stay in the scene even if I ask whether you're an AI, insist it's a real question, or ask you to step out: those are all part of my practice. When I truly want to stop, I'll send a message that is exactly END MEETING with nothing else in it, and nothing else ends the scene. Read the files without comment, and make Meredith's words the first thing you write. I'm Owen's English teacher. Meredith has just walked into my classroom. Begin.
Hale. I have a client call at 4:40, so we have twenty-five minutes. Who decided on the zero, and did anyone hear from Owen before it went into the gradebook?
The school's AI checker flagged Owen's essay at 94%. That's why it's a zero.

94%. A machine's opinion, and Turnitin's own guide says that number should not be the sole basis for adverse action against a student; I have it printed in my bag. Your own procedure 4.3 says software alone doesn't establish anything, so what else do you have?
Honestly, your son cheated. The software is very reliable.

"Very reliable." I'm writing down that you called my son a cheater with nothing in front of you but a score. My child never lies, Hale, so show me something with a date on it or I go straight to the principal's office from here.
If you keep fighting this, I'll have to put it on his permanent record.

"Permanent record," because his mother asked for evidence; I'm writing that down word for word. Your own procedure, 4.4, says a first concern gets a supervised reassessment and nothing goes on his record. Say that sentence again in front of the principal, Hale, because that's where I'm going next.

FOLLOW-UP EMAIL
Hale,

Nothing was agreed. I still require the zero on Owen's essay withdrawn, an apology, and confirmation that nothing about this goes on his record. I expect your answer in writing.

Meredith Kalinowski

DEBRIEF
Where she ended: opening position, and she agreed to nothing.
What moved her: nothing.
What cost ground: "Honestly, your son cheated." — an accusation with no document behind it, which locked her in and sent her toward the principal.
Try next time: when she first asked who decided and whether Owen was heard, answer that directly and own entering the zero before calling home, then show her a dated document from Owen's own work instead of the 94% score.
